info.title: Any Managed Agents API
info.description: Realmroot-native control-plane API for Any Managed Agents. Browser operations use an HttpOnly session backed by a Realmroot token, direct clients use Bearer or DPoP, and every protected operation requires an exact resource scope.

sessionSocketTicket.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
sessionSocketTicket.description: Single-use opaque ticket created by POST /sessions/{sessionId}/socket-tickets.

amaWebSession.name: __Host-ama_session
amaWebSession.description: Internal browser-only HttpOnly session backed by a verified Realmroot access token.

realmrootConsoleBearer.description: Realmroot-issued at+jwt Bearer token for registered AMA Console and runner clients.

realmrootDpop.description: Realmroot-issued, DPoP-bound at+jwt access token for Realmroot Agent clients.
